80fr:
The Foundation Certificate for Science and Engineering at Kaplan International College London is ideal for students looking to enter to the 1st year of an undergraduate degree at university. The course length for students is determined mainly by their English language level.

All students take a set of common or similar modules to gain key skills for university. If their course is longer than 2 terms, they will take extra modules focusing on one or more of English language, academic skills and basic subject knowledge

With computer science and artificial intelligence being one of the most rapidly growing technological developments of our time, Students could be at the forefront of transforming the world around us. During this programme, the students will explore the fundamental concepts of computer science, be introduced to the different areas of AI, and design an individual project based on their own interests.

During this programme, the students will explore the fundamental concepts of computer science, be introduced to the different areas of AI, and design an individual project based on their own interests. The students also have the chance to apply for a year working in industry to put their learning into action or consider spending their third year studying abroad as part of 4-year programme
